:::{#def-probability-measure}
#### Probability measure

A **probability measure** on a [measurable space](#def-measure-space) $(\Omega, \mathscr{F})$
is a [measure](#def-measure) $P$ on $\mathscr{F}$
that gives the whole set $\Omega$ the value $1$:

$$P(\Omega) = 1$$

Then $(\Omega, \mathscr{F}, P)$ is a **probability space**,
$\Omega$ is its **sample space**,
the elements of $\Omega$ are **outcomes**,
and the sets in $\mathscr{F}$ are **events**.

:::
